versions.changelog: Adds a unified PDF, scanned-PDF, DOCX, and TXT to canonical JSON entry point; deterministic derivative generation; reviewed correction application; strict schema, OCR, artifact, and remote read-back validation; and end-to-end regression tests.

Added explicit access and authorization boundaries directly to the published skill. Retains the 1.0.1 forward-test hardening for terminal boundaries, embedded running headers, cross-page footnotes, and OCR/punctuation anomaly review.

Hardened publication-grade validation after a 364-page forward test: reviewed terminal boundaries, embedded running-header removal, page-body/footnote separation, and audits for OCR bullet fallbacks, mixed letter-digit glyphs, stray decorative symbols, duplicated punctuation, and broken citation placement. Added explicit permission boundaries to the skill card.
Initial release: printed-TOC reconstruction, reviewed OCR cleanup, deterministic JSON/TXT generation, safe upload, and full read-back verification.
